thread:
maya: Quick follow-up from last night's partial-response incident. Starting a short remediation sprint to track owners, timelines, and recurring pattern checks. TL;DR: timeouts spike 9-11pm PT, partial responses ~0.6% in that window, reconnect sometimes fails to resume session state.

alex: Which routes are we seeing this on? I saw `/v1/chat/stream` and the websocket gateway.

jordan: Confirmed — both chat stream and gateway. Two different client SDKs reproduced it.

samir: Hypothesis: sudden KV cache eviction on long sessions causing GC/OOM-ish behavior -> connection resets. Adding tracepoints to KV and cache TTLs.

maya: Action items (assigning owners + ETA):
1) alex — implement reconnect backoff with jitter + persist resume-token across reconnects (ETA 3d)
2) jordan — add partial-chunk detection spans + dashboard panels (ETA 2d)
3) samir — run flamegraphs and memory traces for 1-2am PST window (ETA tomorrow)
4) liz — draft customer comms + update SLO language for streaming partials (ETA EOD)
5) harper — own follow-up tracker doc and weekly sync (ETA immediate)

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-243 (P2).

alex: I'll open a PR for reconnect jitter. Quick snippet for the backoff I'm planning: ```js
// exponential backoff with jitter
const wait = Math.min(base * 2**attempt, max) * (0.5 + Math.random()/2);
```

jordan: Observability query I'm adding: `sum(rate(partial_responses[5m])) by (route)` and an alert when rate > 0.3% sustained for 10m. Will add panel to the streaming reliability dashboard.

maya: I'm pinging infra to allocate a tiny canary pool (region us-west-2, low traffic) so we can test changes without impacting prod. Also pinning model variant for canary to a quantized build.

samir: Quick local repro looks promising — KV cache mem pressure spikes when seq_len > 4096. Testing a quantized variant to see if memory footprint drops.

liz: :thumbsup: I'll draft the short note for affected customers and coordinate with Support for any emergent tickets.

harper: I'll kick off a tracker doc and host the first weekly sync Friday 10am PT. Tracker link: https://go/internal/reconnect-signal-sprint (internal).

maya: Status update in 24h. If anyone hits a blocker ping here or page oncall.

alex: PR #4321 opened. Adds resume-token persistence tests and basic jitter. CI running, ETA to ship 48h if green.

jordan: Dashboard panel is live on canary. Early numbers show ~30% reduction in partial spikes on the canary cluster after enabling resume-token persistence.

oncall-bot: Reminder: postmortem writeup due in 72h.

maya: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the short-lived kickoff. I'll post the final tracker link and next steps once the first round of changes land.
